verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents its own fraud tooling: custom rules to detect and mitigate fraud, plus a Profiler that flags bots, VPN usage and suspicious session behavior. That covers only a thin slice of the story, since nothing shows a seller-portfolio risk view, credit-risk scoring, or seller-level controls. Missing for 10: per-sub-merchant fraud and credit-risk signals, alerts on anomalous sellers, tools to pause or hold payouts, seller offboarding, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can watch risk across my seller portfolio — fraud and credit-risk signals per sub-merchant, alerts on anomalous sellers, and tools to pause payouts or offboard bad actors

citations.quote: Define custom logic to detect and mitigate fraud attempts on your platform
Create rules based on the user's interactions and traits of their browsing session, allowing you to detect bots, VPN usage, and other potentially suspicious behavior.
